name: List logs
description: List logs List logs matching the provided filters. GET /v1/logs
context:
GET /v1/logs
List logs matching the provided filters. Logs are paginated by start and end timestamps. There are more logs to fetch if `hasMore` is true in the response. Provide the `nextStartTime` and `nextEndTime` timestamps as the `startTime` and `endTime` query parameters to fetch the next page of logs. You can query for logs across multiple resources, but all resources must be in the same region and belong to the same owner.
Required: ownerId (query) — The ID of the workspace to return logs for; resource (query) — Filter logs by their resource. A resource is the id of a server, cronjob, job, postgres, redis, workflow, or sandbox group.
Optional: startTime (query) — Epoch/Unix timestamp of start of time range to return. Defaults to `now() - 1 hour`.; endTime (query) — Epoch/Unix timestamp of end of time range to return. Defaults to `now()`.; direction (query) — The direction to query logs for. Backward will return most recent logs first. Forward will start with the oldest logs in the time range.; instance (query) — Filter logs by the instance they were emitted from. An instance is the id of a specific running server.; host (query) — Filter request logs by their host. [Wildcards and regex](https://render.com/docs/logging#wildcards-and-regular-expressions) are supported.; statusCode (query) — Filter request logs by their status code. [Wildcards and regex](https://render.com/docs/logging#wildcards-and-regular-expressions) are supported.; method (query) — Filter request logs by their requests method. [Wildcards and regex](https://render.com/docs/logging#wildcards-and-regular-expressions) are supported.; task (query) — Filter logs by their task(s); taskRun (query) — Filter logs by their task run id(s); sandbox (query) — Filter logs by sandbox ID.; level (query) — Filter logs by their severity level. [Wildcards and regex](https://render.com/docs/logging#wildcards-and-regular-expressions) are supported.; type (query) — Filter logs by their type. Types include `app` for application logs, `request` for request logs, and `build` for build logs. You can find the full set of types available for a query by using the `GET /logs/values` endpoint.; text (query) — Filter by the text of the logs. [Wildcards and regex](https://render.com/docs/logging#wildcards-and-regular-expressions) are supported.; path (query) — Filter request logs by their path. [Wildcards and regex](https://render.com/docs/logging#wildcards-and-regular-expressions) are supported.; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

name: List log label values
description: List log label values List all values for a given log label in the logs matching the provided filters. GET /v1/logs/values
context:
GET /v1/logs/values
List all values for a given log label in the logs matching the provided filters.
Required: ownerId (query) — The ID of the workspace to return log label values for; label (query) — The label to query logs for
Optional: startTime (query) — Epoch/Unix timestamp of start of time range to return. Defaults to `now() - 1 hour`.; endTime (query) — Epoch/Unix timestamp of end of time range to return. Defaults to `now()`.; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

name: List log stream overrides
description: List log stream overrides Lists log stream overrides for the provided workspace that match the provided filters. GET /v1/logs/streams/resource
context:
GET /v1/logs/streams/resource
Lists log stream overrides for the provided workspace that match the provided filters. These overrides take precedence over the workspace's default log stream.
Optional: ownerId (query) — The ID of the workspaces to return resources for; logStreamId (query) — Filter log streams by their id.; resourceId (query) — IDs of resources (server, cron job, postgres, or redis) to filter by; setting (query) — Filter log streams by their setting.; cursor (query) — The position in the result list to start from when fetching paginated results. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

name: Subscribe to new logs
description: Subscribe to new logs Open a websocket connection to subscribe to logs matching the provided filters. GET /v1/logs/subscribe
context:
GET /v1/logs/subscribe
Open a websocket connection to subscribe to logs matching the provided filters. Logs are streamed in real-time as they are generated. You can query for logs across multiple resources, but all resources must be in the same region and belong to the same owner.
Required: ownerId (query) — The ID of the workspace to return logs for
Optional: startTime (query) — Epoch/Unix timestamp of start of time range to return. Defaults to `now() - 1 hour`.; endTime (query) — Epoch/Unix timestamp of end of time range to return. Defaults to `now()`.; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).
